Docket 1.3.115

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A favicon check the site refused no longer says the favicon is missing.* When a site's bot check refused
  Docket's request for the favicon (or the server was busy), the report said "No favicon found". A refusal says
  nothing about whether the file exists, so the check now stays quiet. A favicon that is really missing (the
  server says not found) is still reported.
- *A link named by another element is no longer called empty.* Icon links that take their name from a nearby
  heading, the way accessible sites often build cards, were counted as links with no anchor text. Docket now
  reads that name the way a screen reader does. A link that names nothing is still reported.
- *A question asked once per location is counted once.* Some enquiry forms carry the same dropdown once for each
  location and show only the one for the place a visitor picks. Each copy was counted as a field, so a form a
  visitor sees with about a dozen fields was reported with thirty. Dropdowns that share a name now count once.

99 checks across 13 areas.
